$comment: Files for the `starter` universal registry item: drops Rime's root layout, globals, no-flash theme script, providers and font setup into an existing create-next-app project (App Router, no src/, @/* alias). The font file is binary, so it is not in the item: the docs line tells the user to download app/fonts/inter-latin-100-900-normal.woff2 or switch fonts.ts to next/font/google. Overwrites app/layout.tsx and app/globals.css.
name: starter
title: Rime starter: layout, globals and theme setup
description: Root layout with Inter, the no-flash preset and dark-mode script and ToastProvider; globals importing Rime's styles and an empty theme.css.
docs: Put Inter at app/fonts/inter-latin-100-900-normal.woff2 (from the Rime repo, or use next/font/google in app/fonts.ts). Then make your theme in Rime Studio (https://rime.mjsons.net/themes) and paste it into app/styles/theme.css.
